purpose: Post-hoc robustness test of the ACRF/HDBSCAN clustering core only. This is not hyperparameter selection and cannot be used to replace the paper's frozen ACRF-v3.5 settings.

data.quality: GMN sporadics; >=2 stations; median fit error <=180 arcsec; finite radiant/speed; 5<=Vg<=75 km/s; same-time solutions deduplicated by lowest fit error then highest station count
data.target_access: OrbitTrace canonical 2025-2026 timestamps are inaccessible during each HDBSCAN fit and are opened only after all cluster labels for that setting exist, solely to track the corresponding family.

grid.duplicate: The baseline setting occurs in both the scale and HDBSCAN factorials and is executed once.

tracking_rule: After clustering, among recurrent clusters containing events in both 2025 and 2026, choose the cluster with maximum F1 against the 63 canonical 2025-2026 OrbitTrace timestamps; break ties by larger overlap, then higher precision, then smaller cluster size, then EOM before leaf.
stopping_rule: Execute all 153 unique settings. Do not add, delete, narrow, retune, or substitute settings after inspecting results. Report sensitivity as sensitivity; do not pick a better-performing setting.
